capabilities: Index hymn PDF and MP3 files by number
Search hymns by number or keyword
Preview hymn PDFs in a panel
Play hymn MP3s in a player
disambiguation: Not a general music library or audio player; it only indexes hymn PDF and MP3 files named by hymn number.
extras: PDF.js is bundled inside main.js so PDF rendering works on mobile without a Web Worker. On desktop, copying a PDF or MP3 file runs a local OS command (powershell, osascript, xclip or wl-copy) to put that one file on the clipboard. The plugin scans the whole vault to find hymn files and includes an automatic update check.
problem: Hymn PDFs and audio files kept in a vault cannot be searched by hymn number, previewed and played together without leaving Obsidian.

relations.evidence: add ViaCai/Hymns in the BRAT plugin and let it install the latest release

summary: Hymnal browser that indexes hymn PDF and MP3 files in the vault, with search by number or keyword, PDF preview, playback, favourites and playlists.
